name: fse
description: Migration Joomla vers site purement statique HTML/CSS avec pipeline SEO

scripts.build: npm run export && npm run normalize && npm run build:site
scripts.baseline:capture: npm run build && node scripts/check-html-parity.mjs --capture && node scripts/compare-coverage.mjs --capture

scripts.test: npm run export:verify && npm run qa
